segments.title: 第186章 元旦聚餐
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Era Chapter 186: New Year's Day Dinner Party

On the evening of New Year's Day, when Li Luo and Ying Chanxi returned home, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong had prepared a sumptuous dinner to treat the two kids.

Ying Zhicheng was unable to come back for New Year's Day because he was busy with company matters, so Ying Chanxi naturally stayed at Li Luo's house for dinner.

At the dinner table, Lin Xiuhong placed a chicken thigh in Ying Chanxi's bowl and asked the two about their recent studies.

To be honest, Lin Xiuhong, who only had a middle school education, already found the learning content of today's middle school students very difficult to comprehend.

When it came to high school, she was completely in the dark, and could only judge how well they were doing by their grades.

Fortunately, both of their grades were gratifying.

Ying Chanxi was a given, and Li Luo's progress was even faster.

After Li Luo ranked 15th in the entire grade on the last monthly exam, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong were completely at ease about his academic performance.

They rarely mentioned the matter of his writing anymore.

After all, with Li Luo now first in his class and among the top in the entire school, according to the mindset of domestic parents, whatever their child does is right.

When his grades were poor, writing was a bad hobby that interfered with his studies.

When his grades were good, writing was a good habit that helped improve his Chinese scores.

This was especially true during the monthly exam when Li Luo's Chinese essay score was two points higher than even Ying Chanxi's, which further cemented the couple's belief.

Not to mention, writing a novel could even earn money. A monthly manuscript income of twenty to thirty thousand yuan left a lot of surplus even after paying off the mortgage.

Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong would never have dared to dream of such a life before.

So when Li Luo said he was going out to play basketball with Zhao Rongjun tomorrow, Lin Xiuhong immediately nodded in agreement, not forgetting to remind him, "You should also exercise more regularly. You can't just focus on studying. You need to keep your body healthy too."

If it were before.

If Li Luo wanted to go out and play basketball, he would have had to sneak out.

It would never have been like now, where a simple mention would get his parents' approval, and even their support and encouragement.

The Li family didn't have any special programs for New Year's Day. After a good meal, Ying Chanxi accompanied Lin Xiuhong into the kitchen to wash the dishes.

They watched some TV in the living room in the evening, and the couple went to their bedroom to sleep early, as they had to get up early the next morning to open the shop.

Before Ying Chanxi went back to the apartment opposite theirs, she didn't forget to remind him, "Remember to call me when you go play basketball tomorrow."

"Are you really going?" Li Luo said with a helpless smile. "Zhao Rongjun and I will be playing there. You'll be really bored by yourself."

"I'll ask Senior to come along."

"What about Yan Zhusheng?"

"Would three people be too many?" Ying Chanxi asked thoughtfully. "After all, it seems Zhao Rongjun doesn't really like being around a lot of girls."

"It's fine, one more isn't too many."

"Then should I ask Xinyan to come too?"

"Sure." Li Luo nodded. "Why don't we just buy more groceries and have a party over at Bihai Lanting?"

"That's a great idea." Ying Chanxi's eyes lit up, and she nodded, saying, "I'll ask Xinyan and the others if they can have a sleepover. We can hang out longer for New Year's Day."

"Up to you." Li Luo nodded in agreement, silently mourning for Zhao Rongjun in his heart.

After walking Ying Chanxi home, Li Luo returned to his bedroom, took out the notebook Yan Zhusheng had lent him from his schoolbag, and began to write.

Having used up a hundred thousand words of his stockpile in one go today, Li Luo felt a slight pang of regret.

Fortunately, winter break was about a month away, and he would have much more time to write then. Li Luo aimed to get his stockpile back up to the two hundred thousand word mark.

Otherwise, he always felt a sense of unease.

After writing another ten thousand words late at night, Li Luo clicked on the author's backend to take a look. The average subscription count had already risen to over eleven thousand.

It actually should have been able to rise even more.

But he couldn't help that he had updated forty or fifty chapters today... which directly dragged down the growth rate of the average subscriptions.

But none of that mattered anymore.

Li Luo opened the Qidian webpage, flipped to the New Releases Chart and the Bestsellers Chart pages, looked at the image of his book topping both charts, and took a screenshot as a memento.

This achievement, although only temporarily boosted by a wave of traffic, could still be considered a feat.

Even the Xu Youyu from his past life had never reached such heights.

Thinking of this, Li Luo felt quite pleased. He immediately found "Going to Bed Early Makes You Taller" on QQ and sent the screenshot over.

Going to Bed Early Makes You Taller: WTF?! What the hell?

Xu Youyu had only gotten up after ten in the morning today. After having lunch with Li Luo and the others, she saw the three of them off and then went to Bihai Lanting to write.

She wrote until evening, then packed up and went home for a free meal. After dinner, she chatted with her parents on the living room sofa. She had just finished showering and was lying in bed, preparing to read a bit.

But before she could start reading, she received a critical hit from Li Luo.

Chong Ran: Why such a big reaction? I thought you already knew.

Going to Bed Early Makes You Taller: Knew what! Did you eat gunpowder or something? Or did Qidian's system bug out?

Chong Ran: Clearly, this is skill.

Qianjiang University faculty housing.

Xu Youyu was lying on her bed in the bedroom. After seeing the screenshot from Li Luo, she shot up from the bed with a whoosh, looking at it again and again in disbelief.

Then she hurriedly opened the Qidian Reading app and was dumbfounded to find that "I'm Really Not a Star" was truly at the top of both charts.

It was only then that she noticed the tag for the reading event. She clicked in and finally understood what was going on. Xu Youyu then peeked into a few author QQ groups and found that many groups were talking about the book "I'm Really Not a Star."

Some thought it was awesome, that another god-tier book was born.

Others were sarcastic and snide, thinking it was just Qidian deliberately creating another god.

There were even conspiracy theorists who began to suspect whether the song "Years" was written by Chong Ran himself.

They even started to deduce with an air of seriousness, suspecting this was a new marketing plan from within Penguin, directly collaborating with the entertainment industry to carry out a dimensional-reduction strike with traffic, boosting whomever they wanted.

Xu Youyu found it all hilarious after reading through.

But on second thought, she could somewhat understand what these people were thinking.

After all, although "I'm Really Not a Star" had performed quite well before, it was only at the level of a Boutique work.

For it to suddenly jump to number one on both charts, suppressing a host of Great Gods and Platinums, was a bit outrageous.

Then Xu Youyu discovered... that this guy Li Luo had actually updated more than forty chapters today!

Going to Bed Early Makes You Taller: Why did you update so much today???

Chong Ran: It's my stockpile. Didn't I show it to you before? This is only half of it.

As soon as he said that, the other side fell silent.

Only then did Xu Youyu remember that back when her book first went on sale, she had bragged to Li Luo about her own stockpile.

In the end, she was the one who got completely shown up by this kid's stockpile.

Chong Ran: Take a look at this too.

Li Luo sent another screenshot.

Xu Youyu took a closer look and found it was a screenshot of the average subscriptions for "I'm Really Not a Star."

Going to Bed Early Makes You Taller: You've already reached ten thousand subscriptions so quickly???

Xu Youyu glanced at her own author backend. Her current average subscription count was 2957. After grinding for a few more days, she would probably reach the Boutique milestone.

She had originally planned to take a screenshot and show it off to Li Luo when she hit the milestone.

Now, all the flavor was gone.

Seeing the shocked tone of "Going to Bed Early Makes You Taller," Li Luo instantly felt a wave of satisfaction.

He vaguely remembered in his past life, when he was chatting with her, he had finally written a book with Boutique-level results and had eagerly sent her a screenshot to share.

But that damn girl had actually sent him screenshots of two of her books with ten thousand subscriptions, which nearly shattered his Dao Heart.

Being reborn in this life, Li Luo could finally get back at her on this point. The thought of it was quite thrilling.

After all, this was a future Qidian Great God.

Thinking this, Li Luo became even happier.

But at this thought, Li Luo immediately opened his author backend, found the chapter scheduled for automatic release at midnight that hadn't been posted yet, and added a sentence at the end of the main text.

Recommending a Chinese entertainment novel, "The Arts of the Era." Anyone experiencing a book famine can go check it out. It's a bit of a slow burn, but very good.

To be honest, in his previous life, "Going to Bed Early Makes You Taller" had suffered from being a slow burn.

That was why the momentum of her first book was so slow.

In his memory, "The Arts of the Era" didn't have a high first-day subscription count. It wasn't until around June or July of 2015 that it barely achieved the Boutique milestone.

In this life, he didn't know how it was affected, but it had somehow allowed Xu Youyu to reach this condition about half a year earlier.

Since that was the case, Li Luo also thought that if he could provide Xu Youyu with some more promotional support, she might be able to gain attention a bit sooner.

After all, if it were like the previous life, "The Arts of the Era" didn't explode until the end of 2015 due to long-term word-of-mouth fermentation, and then reached the ten-thousand-subscription milestone in mid-2016.

Looking at the situation in this life, this progress could definitely be moved up.

Chong Ran: I'll recommend your book at the end of my midnight chapter. We'll see how it goes then.

Going to Bed Early Makes You Taller: Eh? Really?

Chong Ran: Would I lie to you?

Going to Bed Early Makes You Taller: Thanks a lot, then! I'll treat you to a meal when I get the chance!

Heh... Li Luo smiled, thinking to himself, how many times have you already eaten my food?

Chong Ran: Okay, I'll put it on your tab then.

Going to Bed Early Makes You Taller: Hehe, keep track of it, I won't short you.

Lying on her bed, Xu Youyu looked at the chat log, her mood also a little jubilant.

A chapter recommendation from Li Luo today was different from the past.

After all, it was backed by the traffic of being number one on two charts.

Under these circumstances, with both "The Arts of the Era" and "I'm Really Not a Star" being entertainment novels, the effect might actually be very good.

At the very least, helping her break through the Boutique milestone would definitely not be a problem.

At this thought, Xu Youyu was also thrilled, kicking her legs around on the bed, her two fair and tender feet flailing in the air.

A short while later, another message came on QQ.

At first, Xu Youyu thought it was something else from Li Luo.

But when she took a closer look, she found it was from Ying Chanxi.

Ying Chanxi: Senior, do you want to go play basketball tomorrow? With Li Luo and Zhao Rongjun. Then we can have a party at Bihai Lanting again like yesterday.

(End of this chapter)
